$comment: Third-party MIT projects built on Remotion, the M4 proof. Each is fetched at the pinned commit into .cache/<name> by projects.ts (never vendored). entries: id to the bundle entry (a file that calls registerRoot) and the project script that bundles it, which the oracle mirrors: tailwind is set when that script wraps its webpack config in enableTailwind(), ignoreRegisterRootWarning when it passes that option to bundle() (Remotion looks for the text registerRoot in the entry file; Motio does not need it). Every composition of every entry is compared on the frames sampleFrames() picks. excluded: registerRoot files that are not measured, with the reason. Both renderers use gl swangle (software WebGL, Motio's default): GPU WebGL differs per machine (D-046). skip: compositions of an entry left out of the comparison, with the reason (external or random content, files the repository does not contain). knownMismatch: compositions whose stills are expected to miss the thresholds, with the cause; the test fails once they match, so the marker has to be removed then. knownFlickerMismatch: compositions whose stills match but whose frames around flagged flicker are drawn unlike Remotion for a known cause; those frames are not held to Remotion's.

skip.github-stars: the repository avatar comes from unavatar.io, an external service that rate-limits repeated renders (HTTP 429), and the component then draws the owner's initial instead: the content depends on the service, not on the renderer

skip.backdrop-image: its backdrop is https://picsum.photos/1280/720, a different random photo on every request
skip.chat-flow: the contact avatar comes from unavatar.io, an external service that rate-limits repeated renders
skip.telegram-chat-flow: the contact avatar comes from unavatar.io, an external service that rate-limits repeated renders
skip.imessage-chat-flow: the contact avatar comes from unavatar.io, an external service that rate-limits repeated renders

knownNondeterminism.paper-tear: frames 54-56 differ by one level on 13-32 pixels with GPU compositing, and frames 59-60 on the edge of a fragment in flight, also in JPEG; reported as raster, cause inside Chrome not found (D-091)

skip.release-demo: it plays public/clips/*.mp4, which the public repository does not contain: Motio stops with E_ASSET_NOT_FOUND (D-083) where Remotion draws nothing

excluded.src/remotion/playback-audit-entry.tsx: a page that mounts the Player to measure playback in Chrome, not a bundle of compositions
excluded.scripts/21st/generate.mts: a code generator that writes registerRoot into generated files, not a bundle entry
excluded.src/remotion/jitter-audit-root.tsx: an audit tool that imports Remotion's private Internals (which Motio does not provide by design, doctor warns about it) and registers no composition in Remotion either: there is no video to compare

knownNondeterminism.orbit-gallery: frames 147-149 differ by one level on 8-22 pixels with GPU compositing; reported as raster, cause inside Chrome not found (D-091)

split.script: none (bundled like x-brandwheel-entry.ts, which it mirrors)

x-btngroup.script: none (bundled like x-brandwheel-entry.ts, which it mirrors)

excluded.src/remotion/cuts-entry.ts: imports registry/snap-cn-pro, the paid tier, which the public repository does not contain
excluded.src/remotion/dev-entry.ts: imports registry/snap-cn-pro (the project's dev script aliases it to a stand-in when missing)
excluded.scripts/cuts.mts: a render script, not a bundle entry
excluded.scripts/dev/render-one.mts: a render script, not a bundle entry
